description: Source code for a Java test class 'LoanCOBCreateAccrualsTest' which contains integration tests for loan accounting, accruals, charges, and balance calculations within the Apache Fineract project. The file includes test cases for different loan scenarios such as interest accruals, charges, overpayments, and early repayments, executing business date manipulations and verifying transaction histories.

classes.name: LoanCOBCreateAccrualsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing loan calculations, charges, accruals, and transaction validations in the Fineract system. Extends BaseLoanIntegrationTest and uses Lombok @Slf4j for logging.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test data by creating a loan product and a client if they are not set up yet.

methods.name: chargeAmountLessThanOverpaidAmount
methods.description: Test case for applying a charge with an amount less than the overpaid part of the loan, verifying correct accrual and transaction history.

methods.name: chargeAmountEqualsToOverpaidAmount
methods.description: Test case for applying a charge equal to the overpaid amount, validating the correct handling of overpayment and subsequent accruals.

methods.name: chargeAmountIsGreaterThanOverpaidAmount
methods.description: Test for a charge exceeding the overpaid amount, ensuring system handles overpayment excess properly.

methods.name: testEarlyRepaymentAccruals
methods.description: Simulates early repayment and verifies interest accruals on different dates, ensuring correct computation and transaction records.

methods.name: testInterestRecognitionOnDisbursementDateTrue
methods.description: Verifies interest accrual when interest recognition is enabled on the disbursement date, including accrual transactions on disbursement date.

methods.name: testInterestRecognitionOnDisbursementDateFalse
methods.description: Verifies the system's behavior when interest recognition on disbursement date is disabled, ensuring no accrual on disbursement date.

methods.name: testProgressiveChargeBackNoInterestRecalculation
methods.description: Tests chargeback process with no interest recalculation enabled, validating accruals and transaction consistency after chargeback and repayment.

methods.name: testProgressiveChargeBackInterestRecalculation
methods.description: Tests chargeback scenario with interest recalculation enabled, verifying accrual adjustments over multiple dates.

methods.name: testRunCOBJobAfterUndoDisbursement
methods.description: Checks system behavior after disbursing a loan, running COB, then undoing the disbursement and redeploying, ensuring transaction integrity.

methods.name: chargeForObligationMetLoan
methods.description: Verifies handling of charges on a loan that is fully paid off (obligation met), with various scenarios including penalties.

methods.name: shouldSkipInterestRecalculationWhenNoOverdueInstallments
methods.description: Ensures no interest recalculation occurs if there are no overdue installments.
